generation.note: Eight successful generation jobs are preserved as provenance; four villager portraits remain as runtime admin assets while the world itself is procedural Three.js.

direction.style: Four static villager portraits for the admin queue; the playable village is procedural Three.js low-poly geometry.
direction.view: Portraits are displayed in the HTML admin panel; the world uses an isometric OrthographicCamera.
direction.animation: Villager movement and comment bubbles are rendered by Three.js; portraits are used only in the admin queue.
